benchmark_name: ELITEBUILD Enterprise RAG Gold Evaluation Benchmark

test_cases.query: What is the official legal name and established year of the company?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The official legal entity name is M/S ELITE CONSTRUCTION COMPANY (Engineers & Constructors), established in 2006.

test_cases.query: What Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) licensing category does Elite Construction Company hold?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Elite Construction Company holds PEC Category C-1 (No Limit) registration, authorizing it for unlimited financial value civil engineering and highway works.

test_cases.query: Where are the primary and secondary registered offices of Elite Construction Company located?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The primary office is located at Hamza Tower, F-11 Markaz, Islamabad, and the secondary office is at Jawad Tower, University Road, Peshawar, Pakistan.

test_cases.query: What is the mission of Elite Construction Company?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: To deliver high-grade civil and engineering infrastructure that exceeds regulatory standards, maintains durability, and serves the long-term strategic needs of our clients and communities.

test_cases.query: What is the corporate vision of Elite Construction Company?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: To be recognized as a premier engineering and contracting enterprise in Pakistan, distinguished by technical rigor, transparent execution, and structural integrity.

test_cases.query: What government enlistment does Elite Construction Company hold with the Communication & Works Department?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Elite Construction Company holds prequalified contractor enlistment with the Communication & Works (C&W) Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, for provincial infrastructure, roads, and building construction contracts.

test_cases.query: Which institutional client bodies and government departments has Elite Construction Company worked with?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Documented institutional clients include the Communication & Works Department (C&W), Military Engineering Services (MES), Peshawar Development Authority (PDA), Islamabad / Tribal Electric Supply Companies (IESCO / TESCO), and public-sector universities.

test_cases.query: What capabilities and scope are included in Elite's Civil Construction service?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Comprehensive civil construction capabilities encompassing highway and road corridors, reinforced concrete bridges, drainage networks, institutional and administrative structures, and complex civil engineering groundworks.

test_cases.query: What does Elite Construction Company offer under Rehabilitation and Maintenance services?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Restoration and life-extension of aging civil infrastructure, including emergency rural road rehabilitation, structural repairs, pavement re-carpeting, drainage de-silting, and preventive facility maintenance.

test_cases.query: What project management services does Elite Construction Company provide?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Technical project management adhering to engineering contracts, quality assurance protocols, site supervision, material testing, milestone tracking, and governmental compliance.

test_cases.query: What works were executed for the Dalazak Road repair and rehabilitation project in Peshawar?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Pavement rehabilitation, sub-base preparation, road surfacing, drainage clearing, and municipal corridor improvement extending from Shabistan Cinema / Hayat Hotel toward Dalazak Road via Sabzi Mandi under Communication & Works / Municipal Authorities.

test_cases.query: What was the scope of the Garanga to Sher Killi road improvement project?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Corridor widening, earthworks, sub-grade stabilization, asphalt/surface dressing, and roadside drainage across the Garanga to Sher Killi corridor in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

test_cases.query: Under which program was the Pir Bala to Pir Kala road rehabilitation carried out?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: It was executed under the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rural Road Rehabilitation Project, restoring connectivity, drainage, culvert construction, embankment stabilization, and bituminous surfacing.
expected_citations: Project — Pir Bala to Pir Kala Road Rehabilitation

test_cases.query: What types of educational and institutional buildings has Elite constructed?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: School reconstruction, student hostels, multi-purpose halls, administrative offices, and associated civil infrastructure including structural reinforced concrete, brick masonry, roofing, internal finishes, and utility services.
expected_citations: Project — Institutional Building & Educational Facility Works

test_cases.query: What works were executed for the RCC Bridge and Approach Infrastructure project?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Reinforced cement concrete bridge structures, abutments, piers, superstructure RCC girders and deck slab, expansion joints, approach roads, guide bunds, and scour protection works across water crossings.
expected_citations: Project — RCC Bridge & Approach Infrastructure Works

test_cases.query: What civil and external works were undertaken for the Utility and Water Infrastructure project?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Underground pipeline trenching, manhole construction, storm drains, water distribution networks, sewerage channels, external paving, and boundary demarcation in Regional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
expected_citations: Project — Utility, Water Infrastructure & External Works

test_cases.query: Who was the client authority for the road rehabilitation from Shabistan Cinema to Dalazak Road?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Communication & Works / Municipal Authorities.

test_cases.query: What civil works were executed for the Swat Expressway Package 02?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Dual-carriageway asphaltic roadway construction, earthworks, sub-base, base course, bridge structures, and culverts under client authority.

test_cases.query: What documented experience does Elite have in both highway rehabilitation and RCC bridge structures?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Elite has documented experience in road repair and corridor widening (Dalazak Road, Garanga-Sher Killi, Pir Bala-Pir Kala) and reinforced cement concrete bridge structures including piers, abutments, RCC girders, and approach roads.
expected_citations: Project — RCC Bridge & Approach Infrastructure Works

test_cases.query: What site development and external services does Elite Construction Company provide?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Rough and fine grading, perimeter boundary works, utility trenching, stormwater management, paving, and environmental site works.

test_cases.query: What machinery and plant capabilities does Elite deploy for highway earthmoving and surfacing?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Elite maintains equipment for earthmoving, sub-base preparation, bituminous surfacing, compaction rollers, asphalt pavers, and transit concrete equipment across infrastructure projects.
expected_citations: Equipment & Plant Fleet — Elite Construction Company

test_cases.query: What plant capabilities does Elite deploy for reinforced concrete and bridge structures?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Concrete batching, transit mixing, concrete pumps, vibrators, and formwork systems for structural RCC works, piers, abutments, and deck slabs.
expected_citations: Equipment & Plant Fleet — Elite Construction Company

test_cases.query: Are Elite Construction Company's machinery and plant fleet active and maintained for operations?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Yes, equipment and machinery deployed across active sites are maintained in operational status for civil works execution.
expected_citations: Equipment & Plant Fleet — Elite Construction Company

test_cases.query: Under which government standards and departments has Elite documented field compliance?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Elite has documented field compliance under Military Engineering Services (MES), Communication & Works (C&W), and autonomous development authorities.

test_cases.query: What completion status is recorded for Elite's documented civil infrastructure projects?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Documented infrastructure projects including road repairs, building facilities, and bridge works are verified as COMPLETED.
expected_citations: Project — RCC Bridge & Approach Infrastructure Works

test_cases.query: What quality control and technical supervision protocols does Elite adhere to during construction?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Adheres to engineering contracts, quality assurance protocols, site supervision, material testing, milestone tracking, and governmental compliance.
